newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-KPN says has control of TNT.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-KPN says has control of TNT.

text.p: Dutch postal and telecoms group Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN) said on Friday it declared its A$2.0 billion bid for transport firm TNT Ltd unconditional as it held more than 50 percent of the issued capital.
KPN said it had received acceptances from Bankers Trust Australia Ltd for the 105 million TNT shares held by the investment bank, pushing its stake to 51.9 percent.
KPN has offered A$2.45 per share for TNT's ordinary and preference shares. Its offer is due to close on December 12.
The Dutch firm said its bid was now free of all conditions, including the 90 percent acceptance condition outlined in the early October offer documents.
